featured_reviews.name: Nishant Choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m currently in my second year of BFA at NIFA (National Institute of Fine Arts), and the growth I’ve experienced here has been truly meaningful. In just over a year, my confidence, observation skills, and technical ability have improved in a way that reflects directly in my artworks.

Now, whenever I look at any subject or object, I feel equipped to translate it onto paper or canvas — something I couldn’t imagine before joining. This transformation has been possible because of the solid foundation and consistent mentorship provided at NIFA.

The classrooms are filled with beautiful and inspiring artworks, which constantly motivate us to aim higher. Being in such a creative space naturally builds discipline, focus, and artistic energy.

I’ve trained in multiple mediums here, including fine pen, acrylic, oil paints, watercolor, charcoal, and pencil shading. The guidance from Madhu Sir and Mandar Sir has been the most valuable part of my journey. Their experience, personal attention, and honest feedback have helped me grow both technically and creatively.

Alongside regular classes, NIFA also organizes enriching workshops like the Caricature Art Workshop, which allow us to explore different art styles and techniques beyond the syllabus.

You can view my art journey and progress on Instagram: @nishantchoudhary.arts — a reflection of everything I’ve learned here.

Even as I move forward in my art career, I will always remain a student of NIFA, and of Madhu Sir and Mandar Sir. I’m thankful to be part of this institute and highly recommend it to anyone serious about building their future in fine arts.
